author: Birreh
body:
Hi Avicus

My name is Birreh and I was banned a long time ago for advertising. At the time my brother was playing minecraft on my computer. He went on avicus and advertised not knowing that it was bannable. I was banned by Emmaye. I'm very sorry about my brother advertising on at the time was one of my favourite servers. I'm very sorry for advertising on an amazing server. I hope I can get unbanned and come back and play with my friends.

Hope I get unbanned 

From Birreh :D
